## Youth-deferred ACEs proxy scores for ABCD data

Running this code will create an ACEs proxy score for Baseline, Yr1, Yr2, Yr3, Y4, Y5, Y6 and Y7 with preference given to the youth (vs parent/caregiver) report when available.

KSADS PTSD raw items start for youth at year 6
Need to run the setup file (ELAfromABCD_setup.Rmd) first to create the necessary RDS and CSV files.
IMPORTANT: You will need to run the ENTIRE code to get correct scores for Years 1-7, as they build on each other.

```{r load-packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r load-data}

#read RDS file
ela_in_abcd=readRDS("ela_in_abcd.rds")
mh_py_le_bs=read.csv("mh_py_le_bs.csv")

#create baseline dataset
ela_in_abcd_bs = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-00A", ]

#add in life events "baseline" data
#remove the variable label from main data set and re-add without session_id so the calculated baseline appears inline with other baseline data

ela_in_abcd_bs = ela_in_abcd_bs[c("participant_id","session_id","mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___3","mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___4","mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___5","mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___6","mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___7","mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___8","mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___9", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___10", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___11", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___12", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___13", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___14", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___15", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___16", "fes_youth_q5", "crpbi_y_ss_parent_ace", "demo_fam_exp1_v2", "demo_fam_exp6_v2", "demo_fam_exp7_v2", "asr_totalprob_ace", "asr_q06_p", "asr_q06_p_ace", "famhx_ss_momdad_ma_p", "famhx_ss_momdad_alc_p", "famhx_ss_momdad_dg_p", "famhx_ss_momdad_dprs_p", "famhx_ss_momdad_hspd_p", "famhx_ss_momdad_scd_p", "famhx_ss_momdad_vs_p")]
ela_in_abcd_bs = left_join(ela_in_abcd_bs, mh_py_le_bs, by=c("participant_id")) 

#create separate dfs for remaining time points
ela_in_abcd_yr1 = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-01A", ]
ela_in_abcd_yr2 = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-02A", ]
ela_in_abcd_yr3 = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-03A", ]
ela_in_abcd_yr4 = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-04A", ]
ela_in_abcd_yr5 = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-05A", ]
ela_in_abcd_yr6 = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-06A", ]
ela_in_abcd_yr7 = ela_in_abcd[ela_in_abcd$session_id == "ses-07A", ]

#creating function to sum items in each domain where it will sum across the row as long as at least one variable is not NA
sum_score <- function(x){

  if (all(is.na(x))) {

    suma <- NA
  }  
  else {    
    suma <- sum(x, na.rm = T)
  }

  return(suma)
}

```


```{r baseline-yd}
#abuse_phy
#only parent report available
#KSADS	Shot, stabbed, or beaten brutally by a non-family member	mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___8
#KSADS	Shot, stabbed, or beaten brutally by a grown up in the home	mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___9
#KSADS	Beaten to the point of having bruises by a grown up in the home	mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___10
#KSADS	A non-family member threatened to kill your child	mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___11
#KSADS	A family member threatened to kill your child	mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___12

#create dataframe with phys abuse items
abuse_phy_bs_data = c("mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___8" , "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___9", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___10", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___11", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___12")

#sum the items as long as they're not all NA
ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_phy_sum = apply(ela_in_abcd_bs[abuse_phy_bs_data],1, sum_score)

#binary recode as anything > 0 is 1
ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_phy_yd_bs = ifelse(ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_phy_sum == 0, 0, 1)

#abuse_sex
#only parent report available
#KSADS A grown up in the home touched your child in their privates, had your child touch their privates, or did other sexual things to your childP mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___14
#KSADS An adult outside your family touched your child in their privates, had your child touch their privates or did other sexual things to your childP mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___15
#KSADS A peer forced your child to do something sexuallyP mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___16

#create dataframe with sexual abuse items
abuse_sex_bs_data = c("mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___14" , "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___15", "mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___16")

#sum the items as long as they're not all NA
ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_sex_sum = apply(ela_in_abcd_bs[abuse_sex_bs_data],1, sum_score)

#binary recode as anything > 0 is 1
ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_sex_yd_bs = ifelse(ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_sex_sum == 0, 0, 1)

#abuse_emo
#youth report used for main ACEs variable as well
#Family Environment Family members often criticize each other. fes_youth_q5
#utilizing youth report only to ensure youth exposure (e.g., not parents criticizing without kid present)

#yes/no item; no sum or recode necessary
ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_emo_yd_bs = ela_in_abcd_bs$fes_youth_q5

#neglect_phy
#only parent report available
#Demographics Needed food but couldn't afford to buy it or couldn't afford to go out to get it?P demo_fam_exp1_v2
#Demographics Had someone who needed to see a doctor or go to the hospital but didn't go because you could not afford it?P demo_fam_exp6_v2
#Demographics Had someone who needed a dentist but couldn't go because you could not afford it?P demo_fam_exp7_v2

#create dataframe with physical neglect items
neglect_phy_bs_data = c("demo_fam_exp1_v2", "demo_fam_exp6_v2", "demo_fam_exp7_v2")

#sum the items as long as they're not all NA
ela_in_abcd_bs$neglect_phy_sum = apply(ela_in_abcd_bs[neglect_phy_bs_data],1, sum_score)

#binary recode as anything > 0 is 1
ela_in_abcd_bs$neglect_phy_yd_bs = ifelse(ela_in_abcd_bs$neglect_phy_sum == 0, 0, 1)


#neglect_emo
#youth report used for main ACEs proxy variable as well
#CRPBI parent *CRPBI Mean Parent (primary caregiver)Y crpbi_y_ss_parent_ace

#all recoding done previously
ela_in_abcd_bs$neglect_emo_yd_bs = ela_in_abcd_bs$crpbi_y_ss_parent_ace


#divorce
#Life Events Parents separated or divorced? ple_separ_y
ela_in_abcd_bs$divorce_yd_bs = ela_in_abcd_bs$ple_separ_y_bs


#violence in home (violence)
#only parent report available
#KSADS Witness the grownups in the home push, shove or hit one anotherP 	mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___13

#no recode necessary (binary yes/no variable)
ela_in_abcd_bs$violence_yd_bs = ela_in_abcd_bs$mh_p_ksads__ptsd__screen_001___13


#mental illness
#Life Events Family member had mental/emotional problem? ple_mh_y
ela_in_abcd_bs$mi_yd_bs = ela_in_abcd_bs$ple_mh_y_bs

#Incarcerated Relative
#Life Events Someone in the family was arrested? ple_arrest_y_bs
#Life Events Parents/caregiver got into trouble with the law? ple_law_y_bs
#Life Events One of the parents/caregivers went to jail? ple_jail_y_bs

incar_sum_y_bs_data = c("ple_arrest_y_bs", "ple_law_y_bs", "ple_jail_y_bs")

ela_in_abcd_bs$incar_sum_y = apply(ela_in_abcd_bs[incar_sum_y_bs_data],1, sum_score)

ela_in_abcd_bs$incar_yd_bs = ifelse(ela_in_abcd_bs$incar_sum_y == 0, 0, 1)

#Substance Use
#Life Events Family member had drug and/or alcohol problem?
ela_in_abcd_bs$su_yd_bs=ela_in_abcd_bs$ple_sud_y_bs

#*SUM SCORE*
ela_in_abcd_bs$aces_youth_bs = ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_phy_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_sex_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$abuse_emo_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$neglect_phy_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$neglect_emo_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$divorce_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$violence_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$mi_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$incar_yd_bs + ela_in_abcd_bs$su_yd_bs

```

```{r}
##LONGITUDINAL SCORE CREATION

#join annual follow-up scores to Baseline
#pulling just scores, no session_ids (wide format)
bs_scores = ela_in_abcd_bs[c("participant_id", "aces_youth_bs", "abuse_phy_yd_bs", "abuse_sex_yd_bs", "abuse_emo_yd_bs", "neglect_phy_yd_bs", "neglect_emo_yd_bs", "divorce_yd_bs", "violence_yd_bs", "mi_yd_bs", "incar_yd_bs", "su_yd_bs")]                  
yr1_scores = ela_in_abcd_yr1[c("participant_id", "abuse_emo_yd_yr1", "neglect_phy_yd_yr1", "neglect_emo_yd_yr1", "divorce_yd_yr1", "mi_yd_yr1", "incar_yd_yr1", "su_yd_yr1")]
yr2_scores = ela_in_abcd_yr2[c("participant_id", "abuse_phy_yd_yr2", "abuse_sex_yd_yr2", "abuse_emo_yd_yr2", "neglect_phy_yd_yr2", "divorce_yd_yr2", "violence_yd_yr2", "mi_yd_yr2", "incar_yd_yr2", "su_yd_yr2")]     
yr3_scores = ela_in_abcd_yr3[c("participant_id", "abuse_emo_yd_yr3", "neglect_phy_yd_yr3", "neglect_emo_yd_yr3", "divorce_yd_yr3", "mi_yd_yr3", "incar_yd_yr3", "su_yd_yr3")]
yr4_scores = ela_in_abcd_yr4[c("participant_id", "abuse_phy_yd_yr4", "abuse_sex_yd_yr4", "abuse_emo_yd_yr4", "neglect_phy_yd_yr4", "neglect_emo_yd_yr4", "divorce_yd_yr4", "violence_yd_yr4", "mi_yd_yr4", "incar_yd_yr4", "su_yd_yr4")]     
yr5_scores = ela_in_abcd_yr5[c("participant_id", "abuse_emo_yd_yr5", "neglect_phy_yd_yr5", "neglect_emo_yd_yr5", "divorce_yd_yr5", "mi_yd_yr5", "incar_yd_yr5", "su_yd_yr5")]
yr6_scores = ela_in_abcd_yr6[c("participant_id", "abuse_phy_yd_yr6", "abuse_sex_yd_yr6", "abuse_emo_yd_yr6", "neglect_phy_yd_yr6", "neglect_emo_yd_yr6", "divorce_yd_yr6", "violence_yd_yr6", "mi_yd_yr6", "incar_yd_yr6", "su_yd_yr6")]
yr7_scores = ela_in_abcd_yr7[c("participant_id", "abuse_phy_yd_yr7", "abuse_sex_yd_yr7", "abuse_emo_yd_yr7", "neglect_phy_yd_yr7", "neglect_emo_yd_yr7", "divorce_yd_yr7", "violence_yd_yr7", "mi_yd_yr7", "incar_yd_yr7", "su_yd_yr7")]


yr1 = left_join(bs_scores,yr1_scores, by=c("participant_id")) 
yr2 = left_join(yr1, yr2_scores, by=c("participant_id")) 
yr3 = left_join(yr2, yr3_scores, by=c("participant_id")) 
yr4 = left_join(yr3, yr4_scores, by=c("participant_id")) 
yr5 = left_join(yr4, yr5_scores, by=c("participant_id")) 
yr6 = left_join(yr5, yr6_scores, by=c("participant_id")) 
ela_final = left_join(yr6, yr7_scores, by=c("participant_id")) 

#save bs data
#prep for return to long format
bs_scores$session_id="ses-00A"
lookup = c(aces_proxy_yd="aces_youth_bs", abuse_phy = "abuse_phy_yd_bs", abuse_sex = "abuse_sex_yd_bs", abuse_emo = "abuse_emo_yd_bs", neglect_phy = "neglect_phy_yd_bs", neglect_emo = "neglect_emo_yd_bs", divorce = "divorce_yd_bs", violence = "violence_yd_bs", mental = "mi_yd_bs", incar = "incar_yd_bs", sud = "su_yd_bs")
bs_scores=rename(bs_scores, all_of(lookup))

#building score - adding items by timepoint
#for each domain, if current and any/all previous timepoints 0, will be 0; otherwise, 1

#yr1 by domain
ela_final$abuse_phy_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$abuse_phy_yd_bs == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$abuse_sex_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$abuse_sex_yd_bs == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$abuse_emo_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$abuse_emo_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$abuse_emo_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$neglect_phy_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$neglect_phy_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$neglect_phy_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$neglect_emo_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$neglect_emo_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$neglect_emo_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$divorce_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$divorce_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$divorce_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$violence_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$violence_yd_bs == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$mi_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$mi_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$mi_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$incar_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$incar_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$incar_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$su_yr1_build = ifelse(ela_final$su_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$su_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)

#yr1 sum score
ela_final$aces_yr1_yd_build = ela_final$abuse_phy_yr1_build + ela_final$abuse_sex_yr1_build + ela_final$abuse_emo_yr1_build + ela_final$neglect_phy_yr1_build + ela_final$neglect_emo_yr1_build + ela_final$divorce_yr1_build + ela_final$violence_yr1_build + ela_final$mi_yr1_build + ela_final$incar_yr1_build + ela_final$su_yr1_build

#save yr1 data
yr1_scores_final = ela_final[c("participant_id", "aces_yr1_yd_build", "abuse_phy_yr1_build", "abuse_sex_yr1_build", "abuse_emo_yr1_build", "neglect_phy_yr1_build", "neglect_emo_yr1_build", "divorce_yr1_build", "violence_yr1_build", "mi_yr1_build", "incar_yr1_build", "su_yr1_build")]

#prep for return to long format
yr1_scores_final$session_id="ses-01A"
lookup = c(aces_proxy_yd = "aces_yr1_yd_build", abuse_phy = "abuse_phy_yr1_build", abuse_sex = "abuse_sex_yr1_build", abuse_emo = "abuse_emo_yr1_build", neglect_phy = "neglect_phy_yr1_build", neglect_emo = "neglect_emo_yr1_build", divorce = "divorce_yr1_build", violence = "violence_yr1_build", mental = "mi_yr1_build", incar = "incar_yr1_build", sud = "su_yr1_build")
yr1_scores_final=rename(yr1_scores_final, all_of(lookup))

#yr2 by domain
ela_final$abuse_phy_yr2_build = ifelse(ela_final$abuse_phy_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$abuse_phy_yd_yr2 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$abuse_sex_yr2_build = ifelse(ela_final$abuse_sex_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$abuse_sex_yd_yr2 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$abuse_emo_yr2_build = ifelse(ela_final$abuse_emo_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$abuse_emo_yd_yr1 == 0 & ela_final$abuse_emo_yd_yr2 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$neglect_phy_yr2_build = ifelse(ela_final$neglect_phy_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$neglect_phy_yd_yr1 == 0 & ela_final$neglect_phy_yd_yr2 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$neglect_emo_yr2_build = ifelse(ela_final$neglect_emo_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$neglect_emo_yd_yr1 == 0, 0, 1)
ela_final$divorce_yr2_build = ifelse(ela_final$divorce_yd_bs == 0 & ela_final$divorce_yd_yr1 == 0 & ela_final$divorce_yd_yr2 == 0, 0, 1)
```
